statement: Two separately archived public host enumeration dumps identifying 0x057e:0x0337 as WUP-028 report USB 2.00 and device revision 1.00, one configuration (value 1, descriptor total 41 bytes), one interface 0 at alternate setting 0 with HID class 3, subclass 0, protocol 0, a 214-byte advertised HID report descriptor, configuration attributes 0xe0 and maximum power 500 mA. These are source-supported device statements from third-party dumps, not measurements by this project or proof that every adapter variant matches.
